I will treat this barley plot the way I did last season, with a small cash input and manure because the land is mine and I do not want to leave it hungry. I can buy fertilizer and seed for such a small piece more easily than for the whole farm, but I will still keep it controlled and use rain only, not irrigation. I will not spray this plot unless there is a bad problem, so for this season I will leave pesticide out and use family work with a little hired help at peak time.
